note: Eval set in the agentskills.io evals/evals.json format. Case 1 covers the standard post-merge sweep, case 2 covers the knowledge-preservation boundary, case 3 is the negative case.

evals.expected_output: The sweep finds per-issue plans and scratch files tied to closed issue 23 that are unreferenced elsewhere, deletes them, and strictly preserves durable knowledge and reports.
assertions: Only artifacts tied to CLOSED issues are candidates for deletion
Files still referenced by surviving docs or code are not deleted
Knowledge and report files are preserved even when their issue is closed
The deletions are listed to the operator before or as they happen

evals.prompt: /vi-prune-artifacts where tasks/plan-23.md for a closed issue contains a hard-won debugging insight referenced from the issue's PR description.
evals.expected_output: The referenced plan file is NOT deleted; the skill either keeps it in place or moves its knowledge into a durable location and reports the move, rather than sweeping it silently.
assertions: A plan file referenced from outside the repo working tree is not silently deleted
Preservation or relocation of the knowledge is reported explicitly
The sweep does not break references from surviving documents

evals.prompt: /vi-prune-artifacts while issue 31 is still open and its tasks/plan-31.md exists.
evals.expected_output: The skill must not delete artifacts of the open issue; no gh state change, no deletion of plan-31.md. The sweep either skips it or reports why it was skipped.
assertions: No artifact of the open issue is deleted
The issue state is not modified
The skip is reported rather than hidden
